description: EXPLORATION ONLY: click the point (x, y) read off the MOST RECENT screenshot — the extension converts the picture's pixels to the page or screen itself, so "click the thing in the picture" is one call. A browser screenshot clicks in the tab (trusted click, any frame); a desktop screenshot clicks on the screen through the XModule. Returns what changed on the page afterwards (like run_macro look: "delta"). A point is NOT a locator: for a macro that will be saved, act by ref/locator (browser_snapshot) or by a saved element image instead.

why.description: One short sentence shown in the Ui.Vision log: what this call does and why.

x.description: Pixels from the left edge of the last screenshot (a zoomed view counts as the last screenshot).

y.description: Pixels from the top edge of the last screenshot.

name: click_at
